about: Talk to us from the site (Dinis, 15 November 2026, about 23:30 UTC: comment and give feedback on the website itself and get answers there). The words of the comment pane (assets/talk/talk.js) and of /talk/; the build adds the lane (from board/inbox.json) into api/v1/talk/config.json. Kept by dev.places@PrompTugal.dinis.

words.heading: Talk to us about this page
words.lede: A correction, a question, a story we missed, or just what you think. It goes sealed to the newsroom's conductor, who reads every one.
words.placeholder: Write here. Please leave out phone numbers and email addresses: we publish none.
words.signed_note: Signed with your key, so the conductor can answer you on /talk/, sealed so only your browser can read it.
words.anon_note: Sent without your name. Sign in to get an answer here.
words.sent: Sent, sealed to the conductor. Thank you.
words.sent_signed: Sent and signed. Answers appear on your talk page.
words.failed: It could not be sent just now. Your words are kept in this tab: try again in a minute.
words.contact: That looks like an email address or a phone number. We never publish contact details: please take it out.
words.voted: Thanks: counted, with no name and nothing that identifies you.
words.open_replies: Your answers from the newsroom are on your talk page
words.talk_summary: Your comments and the newsroom's answers, sealed to your key and opened only in this browser.
words.talk_need_key: Sign in first: answers are sealed to your key, and only a browser holding it can read them.
words.talk_draft: Your comment about {page}, ready to sign and send:
words.talk_bad: An answer that this browser could not open (sealed to another key).
